context: A coach and athlete review a difficult competition with mixed results
purpose: Teach: いかにも/網/打っ/満ち/回避/っぱなし/じっと/マル

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 今日の試合、いかにもお前らしい走りやったわ。前半は自信に満ちてたな。
lines.en: Today's race was so very like you. In the first half you were full of confidence.
lines.style: Warm Kansai coach, gruff but affectionate, opening with honest praise.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。でも後半、相手の網にかかったみたいに動けなくなって…
lines.en: Thank you. But in the second half, it was like I got caught in their net and couldn't move.
lines.style: Polite university student, frustrated but reflective tone, honest self-assessment.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: せやな。あそこで一発打ってたら流れ変わってたかもしれん。リスク回避ばっかり考えすぎや。
lines.en: Right. If you'd taken one shot there, the flow might have changed. You're thinking too much about avoiding risk.
lines.style: Direct Kansai coaching critique, casual dialect, pointing out hesitation clearly.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 守りっぱなしになってましたね。怖くて、じっと様子見してしまいました。
lines.en: I was stuck on defense the whole time. I got scared and just stared, waiting and watching.
lines.style: Self-critical university athlete admitting a clear mental mistake to coach.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: ま、悪い部分ばっかちゃうで。スタートのキレ、あれにはマル付けたるわ。
lines.en: Well, it wasn't all bad parts. Your sharpness at the start, I'll give that a circle mark.
lines.style: Kansai coach softening criticism with specific praise, using teacher-grading metaphor.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 次は最後まで攻め切ります。映像見直して、課題ちゃんと潰してきます。
lines.en: Next time I'll keep attacking to the end. I'll review the footage and properly fix my problems.
lines.style: Determined recovery declaration, formal but earnest student-to-coach commitment.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: その意気や。明日から練習メニュー組み直すから、覚悟しときや。
lines.en: That's the spirit. From tomorrow I'm rebuilding your training menu, so be ready.
lines.style: Encouraging Kansai-dialect closer, half threat half motivation, coach-style banter.
